---
title: "External Resources"
---

## Analysis pipelines and tutorials

-   [QIIME2 documentation](https://docs.qiime2.org) — tutorials, plugin references, and a community forum for the most widely used microbiome analysis platform
-   [nf-core/ampliseq](https://nf-co.re/ampliseq) — a Nextflow pipeline for amplicon sequencing analysis maintained by the nf-core community
-   [DADA2 tutorial](https://benjjneb.github.io/dada2/tutorial.html) — R-based ASV pipeline
-   [phyloseq tutorials](https://joey711.github.io/phyloseq/) — R package for microbiome data analysis and visualization
-   [National Microbiome Data Collaborative Microbiome Scence Certificate Program](https://microbiomedata.org/certificate-program/) — Overarching, in-depth overview of microbiome analyses free for public

## Reference databases and comparative datasets

-   [Earth Microbiome Project](https://earthmicrobiome.org) — protocols, reference databases, and comparative datasets
-   [Silva database](https://www.arb-silva.de) — rRNA reference database for taxonomy assignment
-   [Greengenes2](https://greengenes2.ucsd.edu) — updated 16S reference database
